A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the learning psychology and behavior of students majoring physical education was generally good;there were still some problems in their learning psychology and behaviors.

the students had a strong sense of self awareness,their national awareness was weak and their learning interest was not strong;their learning objectives were not specific enough,and their learning manner was not good.

the students majoring in PE had a high level of self- awareness and self-confidence,but their awareness of national identity was relatively low;the learning objectives were not clear and specific enough;there was a problem that they focused more on skills learning rather than academic study,and the degree of learning was gradually decreased;they had a good learning habit and time schedule,but their learning manner needed to be improved.
The main takeaway from our work is that

we should pay more attention to the learning psychology and behavior of students majoring physical education,improve the quality of physical education majors,enhance their sense of national belonging,and promote them to become a group of high quality talents who are qualified to teach physical education.
